div.head: Ine 76.2
div.ab: Gif he ðonne on þone geonbyrde þe hine sloh, ðonne ætfealle sio bot ðæm godfæder, swa same swa þæt wite ðam hlaforde deþ.
Gif he þonne on þone geonbyrde þe hine slog, þonne ætfealle sio bót þæm godfæder, swa ilce swa þæt wite þam hlaforde deð.
Si de parentela ipsius sit qui occidit eum, tunc excidat emendatio patrini, sicut manbota domini.
Gif he þonne on þone geonbryde þe hine slog, þonne ætfealle sio bot þam godfæder, swa ilce swa þæt wite ðam hlaforde deð.
If [the decedent], however, was resisting in a fight the one who slew him, the compensation to the godfather is nullified, just as is the fine due to the lord.
If, however, he was engaged in a struggle with him who slew him, the godfather shall lose his compensation, just as [in similar circumstances] the lord loses his fine.
If, however, he was resisting him who slew him, then the compensation to the godfather is remitted, in the same way as the fine to the lord is.

Falls jener jedoch auf denjenigen, der ihn tödtete, losgeschlagen hatte, dann entgehe diese Busseneinnahme dem Taufvater ebenso wie jene Strafgeldeinnahme [aus Mannbusse in solchem Falle] dem Herrn entgeht.
But if that man had attacked the one who killed him, then let this compensation be lost to the godfather, just as that fine-income [from man-compensation in such a case] is lost to the lord.
